name: Space Shuttle translational hand controller
view: the THC from behind, as the crew member sees it: the T-handle on its short shaft above the housing; the handle is pushed the way the orbiter should translate (forward/aft, left/right, up/down)
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the T-handle and housing reconstructed from the NASA Space Shuttle crew operations and news reference descriptions of the THC and public NASA photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
